author: Paco
scope: Course documentation and 16:9 Beamer, not a journal submission
data: 30 fresh trials rerun after the launcher startup fix, with unchanged dataset, workloads, token layouts and plotting style; no observations excluded.

figures.movement: Fixed dataset: all ten settings, changed-owner counts and fractions; model references qualified in text.
figures.balance: All nine fixed V layouts before and after join; population CV, no layout uncertainty implied.
figures.node-loads: L01 finite population of four physical-node loads; all 36 marks shown, no confidence-interval claim.
figures.key-shares: Each bar totals 100%; A/B/C/D keep the same spatial order and use direct percentages.
figures.requests: Same key counts versus uniform and cumulative hot traffic; all three denominators stated.
figures.transfers: Same-scale 3x4 matrices; counts and percentages, retained diagonal outlined.
figures.join-cost: All 30 actual timings; vertical offsets separate repeated observations, diamonds mark means.

reviewed_source_preflight_warnings.TIFF: PDF/SVG are the vector deliverables; PNG is a 300-dpi course preview, not a journal raster submission.
reviewed_source_preflight_warnings.DPI: 300-dpi PowerPoint packaging is intentional; the primary Beamer PDF remains vector.
reviewed_source_preflight_warnings.width: 9.4-inch working canvas targets documentation and slide scaling, not a journal column.

plot_audits: Seven alignment records, seven PDF font checks, seven collision checks with no findings, and source preflight; no accessibility certification claimed.
